findings.description: The regex `[a-z']+` runs on the raw question without lowercasing, so capitalized reference words such as "It", "This", "Also" or "Same" never match the lowercase REFERENCE_WORDS set. Only the first letter is lost, so "Also, what about flaps?" yields "lso" and misses the reference.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a follow-up beginning with a capitalized reference word, e.g. "Also, what about the flaps?", where the initial retrieval is weak. Mechanism: refers_to_previous_turn returns False because the token is split into "lso" and "hat"-style fragments, so the retry with the previous question is skipped. Impact: the follow-up is answered from weak retrieval, and the model abstains or answers without the conversational context the retry was meant to supply.
